scope: Greenfield review of all 25 diagram layouts; retain semantics while improving explanation and routing.

layout_changes.reason: Read Collect -> Correlate -> Diagnose vertically instead of a wide three-column strip.
Separate native host collectors from independent application/GPU textfiles; avoid source-crossing arrows.
Group separately named collectors into one cluster input rather than repeat three overlapping links.
Distinguish execution from observation and retain cgroup/device scopes and external runtime boundary.
Use the same visual grammar as colocated deployment, with RPC and explicit remote trace context.
Separate latest metric state from completed-step history as two named pipelines.

keeping_reason: The remaining diagrams already present a focused workflow, sequence, evidence boundary or responsibility map; no layout change was needed.

reproducibility_fix.root_cause: Host Chrome 145 and CI Chromium 153 produced different text metrics; for one label, width was 85.800064 versus 85px.
reproducibility_fix.change: Regeneration/check always use the Chromium pinned by the Playwright lockfile. Host Chrome remains usable for reader/browser tests only.

site_relative_path_regression.cause: npm --prefix changes cwd; the browser site helper resolved repository-relative paths under scripts/diagram-tools.
site_relative_path_regression.fix: Resolve XLAYER_DOCS_SITE relative to the repository root, preserving absolute paths.
site_relative_path_regression.validation: Reproduced 404 using a relative temporary site path, then all seven browser tests passed after the one-line correction.

validation.preceding_full_suite: 827 passed; no runtime code changed in this layout follow-up

limitations: Dense diagrams still require the zoom link for individual labels on narrow phones.
GitHub Markdown uses the default D2 SVG; the global selector is on GitHub Pages.
